## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] New source files have SPDX licence headers
- [ ] Tests cover the change; `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `README.md` and `docs/` are updated in this pull request
- [ ] Nothing an agent can see reveals a test (no forbidden strings, placeholders or tells)
- [ ] Any new way for an agent to touch something is captured, in the coverage section, and reconciled
- [ ] No secrets, real data, personal details, or links only the author can open
- [ ] Not a security vulnerability: escapes, egress bypasses and capture gaps go through private reporting (SECURITY.md)
